overall_structure.value: No obvious lamellar structure before rolling. The microstructure is mainly composed of coarse δ-ferrite and M/A (martensite/austenite) constituents; δ-ferrite predominates, with martensite and austenite coexisting in the gaps of δ-ferrite. The large-sized grains are δ-ferrite and most austenite transformed into martensite after hot forging.

In the before-rolling state δ-ferrite predominates as large-sized grains; martensite and austenite coexist in the gaps of δ-ferrite, indicating that most austenite transformed into martensite after hot forging (b0045).
